display_name: 固定 SIG_TIME：时序自挑战训练首种子三臂
description: Fixed SIG_TIME/default jointly trained head, original oldgate/ownEMA/cos SSL. Three scratch50 arms: identical probe-cost SIG_TIME, matched-random temporal masking, and signed-gradient temporal RSC. No feature-architecture or head-fitting changes; historical oldgate+cos reused.
authorization: User active84% goal and latest instruction to fix SIG_TIME architecture and prioritize DG/SSL training mechanisms; default classifier jointly trained, oldgate+cos reference, <=50epochs/model. No target feedback or independent fitted classifier.

code.environment: Ordinary N607 existing CVS-RFFI, full FP32, CPU2threads/worker; no environment mutation

data.representation: Approved existing source IQ2x256; fixed SIG_TIME post-dropout t2; L6300/U56700 TX hidden/V27000 health-only; same split392005/physical roles/NoExplicitCFO. Masking only L intermediate feature during training; no query/target training.

execution.gpu_policy: shared capacity lock; all owners max3 processes/GPU and >=12000MiB free; no stop/restart/hot-edit of existing runs
execution.stop_rule: Only run-owned systemic technical failures: current data/default-head/hidden-U mismatch, nonfinite loss/gradients, unidentifiable fixed mask, failed RNG replay, missing updates, repeated launch failure or immutable-output collision. Preserve partial outputs; no automatic retry, unrelated stop/restart or target-feedback changes. Scientific source-rule FAIL prevents expansion but all fixed first-seed rows still finish/scored.

notes: Prospective training pilot fixed by source-only three-model report commit84579f608289b6c103b503be816c16807ae4ddb7; no target-derived masking/parent/schedule choices. Existing target history is known; do not claim independent blind benchmark.
Fixed network/default classifier normal joint optimization only; no new parameters, classifier refit, diagnostic fitted head or additional optimizer step.

Three L forwards per step: original, spatial-all probability-drop observation, selected mask; same train-mode dropout RNG replay and ambient RNG preserved. SIG_TIME returns original output graph after equal-cost observation. Extra forwards independently counted.
Random arm shares own-current-model selected packet set and per-packet zero counts; trained arms can select different physical packets. No claim of across-arm packet-set identity.

Source expansion frozen before launch: all arms last5 unmasked L CE<=.5, exact budgets/default boundary, both variants changed actual deployment features>=1e-6 and nonzero actual t1/t2/SIG delta at17/33/50. Commit/push source decision before reading new target numbers, extend all three unchanged02/03 only if PASS.
All fixed first-seed rows complete50 and automatic clean168000 default-head predictions→independent truth-last even if scientific source qualification FAIL. n1 cannot complete84% goal.
One bounded independent P0/P1 review; identified release dependency fixed and targeted confirmation required. No unrelated workflow gates or refits.
Raw IQ, checkpoints, PT vectors, logs and predictions stay off Git; code/config/preregistration and positive or negative aggregate results committed/pushed with remote OID verification.

Technical recovery r02: original r01 dispatcher stopped before any worker/update because redacted registration did not match full factory configs. Keep complete canonical config fields with PROJECT prefix handle and restore only that prefix in scoped registration read; preserve old remote outputs. Numerical method and budgets unchanged.
